description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Patron of the Wild, adding {C}{C}.
When Patron of the Wild dies, Yedora triggers, returning Patron of the Wild from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Patron of the Wild by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Patron of the Wild's morph ability by paying {2}{G}, turning it face up.
Patron of the Wild triggers, giving target creature +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
